summary: Iteration 4 — Phase A of P1 roadmap (Stripe Subscriptions + Admin API) is FULLY WORKING. 21/21 pytest tests PASS (100%) in /app/backend/tests/test_subscriptions_admin.py. Coverage: (1) GET /api/subscription/plans PUBLIC returns 4 plans (free/pro/business/premium) with feature_lines + stripe_configured=true for all paid tiers, (2) GET /api/subscription/me returns plan_id='free', credits_monthly=20, features.rag=false, features.hub_chat_public=false for the test user, (3) GET /api/features/me mirrors the same payload, (4) POST /api/subscription/checkout with plan_id='pro' returns a Stripe TEST subscription Checkout URL (https://checkout.stripe.com/c/pay/cs_test_...) AND lazily creates a Stripe Customer that is persisted at user.subscription.stripe_customer_id (verified by direct Mongo read after the request), (5) checkout {plan_id:'free'} → 400 'free plan does not require checkout', (6) checkout {plan_id:'unknown'} → 400 'plan ... has no Stripe price configured', (7) portal BEFORE any customer exists → 400 'no Stripe customer for this user — subscribe first', (8) WEBHOOK customer.subscription.created (HMAC-SHA256-signed with STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET, items.data[0].price.id=STRIPE_PRICE_PRO_MONTHLY, customer=fake cus_test_xxx pre-linked via Mongo) → 200 received:true and /api/subscription/me now shows plan_id='pro' status='active', (9) WEBHOOK invoice.paid with billing_reason='subscription_cycle' → +300 credits (Pro monthly) and wallet_events row source='subscription_renewal'; replay with a different event_id but same invoice_id → idempotent via stripe_invoices._id (no extra credits), (10) WEBHOOK customer.subscription.deleted → status='canceled' and get_effective_plan() collapses to plan_id='free', (11) ADMIN /api/admin/health: missing X-Admin-Key → 401, wrong key → 403, valid ETOH_ADMIN_API_KEY → 200 {ok:true} (hmac.compare_digest used — timing-safe), (12) ADMIN /api/admin/metrics/summary returns all required fields (users_count, active_subscriptions, subscriptions_by_plan, mrr_eur, arr_eur=mrr*12, signups_30d, hub_items, hub_public_views, llm_events_30d, generated_at ISO), (13) ADMIN POST /api/admin/users/{uid}/credits: delta=0 → 400, unknown user → 404, valid {delta:50, reason:'test'} → 200 ok:true + credits+50 + wallet_events row with source='admin' reason='test'. REGRESSION: existing one-shot credit-pack flow still works — POST /api/wallet/checkout {pack_id:'starter'} returns a Stripe checkout URL; checkout.session.completed webhook with metadata.pack_id='starter' still credits +100; GET /api/, /api/auth/me, /api/hub/me, /api/crm/contacts, /api/dashboard/metrics, /api/wallet/packs all return 200. NO production bugs found.
action_items: OPTIONAL (not blocking): server.py is now ~2800 lines. Splitting into routers (auth, subscription, admin, stripe, hub, crm, wallet, coach, studio, pilot) would make Phase B onboarding easier — strongly recommended before adding more endpoints (3rd time flagged).

OPTIONAL: GET /api/subscription/me returns status=null for users that never subscribed — the React Native UI must handle that explicitly when rendering the 'Current plan' badge (don't show 'Status: null').
critical_code_review_comments: Subscription plan→price mapping via core.subscriptions.get_stripe_price_id(plan_id) reads env vars STRIPE_PRICE_{TIER}_MONTHLY at call time — good, no module-level caching. All three (pro/business/premium) resolve from backend/.env L18-20.

_get_or_create_stripe_customer (server.py L694) handles stale customer ids: stripe.Customer.retrieve() in a try/except, and on failure re-creates with metadata.app_user_id=<user_id> — that metadata is the safety net used by _handle_subscription_upsert when the user-customer link isn't yet in Mongo (L574-582). Tested via webhook with metadata fallback path.
Admin auth uses hmac.compare_digest(provided, ETOH_ADMIN_API_KEY) (L827) — timing-safe, correct. Missing header → 401, wrong key → 403, unconfigured key → 503. All three branches verified.

Webhook idempotency is now LAYERED: (a) stripe_events unique index on event_id catches replays of the same Stripe event, (b) stripe_invoices._id=invoice_id catches the case where Stripe sends two DIFFERENT events (e.g. invoice.payment_succeeded + invoice.paid) for the same invoice. Test_invoice_paid_credits_monthly_amount sends two distinct event ids with the same invoice_id and asserts credits unchanged on the replay — works as designed.

_handle_subscription_deleted (L602) correctly DOWNGRADES plan_id to PLAN_FREE (= 'free') and sets cancel_at_period_end=False so get_effective_plan() returns 'free' even before the next /me fetch. No orphan 'pro+canceled' state.

_handle_invoice_paid (L621) filters billing_reason to ('subscription_cycle','subscription_create','subscription_update') — so credit-pack invoices (mode=payment) are NOT double-credited (the checkout.session.completed branch already handles them). Critical separation.

_plan_id_from_price (L545) iterates PLANS and matches against env vars — O(n) but n=3, fine. Returns None for unknown price ids and the handler logs+returns without touching the user (L568). No silent misattributions.
seed_data_creation: Pre-test: snapshotted user.credits and user.subscription, then cleared user.subscription for deterministic state. Webhook tests pre-link user.subscription.stripe_customer_id to a unique FAKE_CUSTOMER_ID (cus_test_etoh_<8hex>) via direct Mongo write so the subscription.created event resolves to the correct user without going through real Stripe Checkout. Post-test cleanup: deleted stripe_invoices rows with customer_id=FAKE_CUSTOMER_ID, deleted wallet_events with source in ('subscription_renewal','admin') for this user, restored credits to baseline, restored original subscription dict (or unset if none). The real Stripe Customer created during test_checkout_pro_returns_stripe_subscription_url is left in place — it's a TEST-mode customer (sk_test_) so it doesn't matter, and removing it would require a Stripe API call.
